scripts.features:
✈️ Smart Flight

Smooth and responsive flight control with precise adjustment of both speed and altitude, giving you complete control over movement.

🧱 Noclip

Move freely through obstacles, walls, and buildings, allowing you to bypass physical barriers with ease.

⚡ Teleportation

Instantly teleport a selected distance or launch yourself upward for fast repositioning and quick movement.

🤾 Throw & Push

Provides multiple built-in throw and push actions for your character, designed for quick and convenient use.

🏃 Smart Walking

Advanced movement control with adjustable speed, allowing faster and more responsive walking than standard movement systems.

🧭 Direction Lock

Locks your character's movement to a specific direction, providing precise directional control while flying or walking.

🗺️ Map & Exploration Tools

🔍 Player Tracking

Advanced player-tracking technology that helps locate and follow other players accurately across the map.

📍 Save Locations

Save important locations and organize them for quick access whenever needed with a single button press.

🛤️ 3D Path

A visual 3D navigation system that helps identify paths and movement routes, making exploration and navigation easier.

🎯 Advanced Combat Panel

A dedicated combat and movement interface that brings essential gameplay tools together in one convenient panel.

🔫 Advanced Aim System

🎯 Aimbot

What it does: Automatically moves the camera or crosshair toward the fastest visible player entering the configured Field of View (FOV).

Benefit: Reduces the need for manual aiming and can automatically switch to the next visible target after the current target is eliminated.

🔥 Auto-Fire

What it does: Automatically triggers the weapon when a valid target is detected and engaged.

Benefit: Removes the need for repeated manual firing, allowing the aiming and firing system to operate together automatically.

👁️ Field of View Customization

What it does: Allows you to adjust the size and position of the targeting field, including a centered FOV or cursor-based positioning.

Benefit: Gives you complete control over the targeting area, whether you prefer a focused center area or a wider, more flexible setup.

⏱️ Aim Speed

What it does: Uses an adjustable slider to control how quickly the camera moves toward a selected target, from slow and precise movement to near-instant targeting.

Benefit: Allows you to fine-tune the aiming behavior according to your preferred movement speed and play style.

🟥 Combat Radar / ESP

What it does: Works alongside the aiming system to display red boxes around visible players and show their names.

Benefit: Provides a clear overview of nearby opponents, making it easier to identify targets even when the environment partially obstructs visibility.

🚀 Automatic First-Time Setup

⚙️ One-Click Initialization

What it does: The first time you activate the Aimbot, the system automatically creates the required configuration file and initializes the Aimbot, Auto-Fire, ESP, and startup features together.

Benefit: Everything is configured automatically with a single action, eliminating the need to activate and configure each feature individually.

⚙️ User Interface & Languages

🌍 Dynamic Localization

What it does: The interface and menus support four languages: Arabic, English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Benefit: Changing the language immediately updates button names, menus, and options throughout the interface without requiring a restart.
